name: Tooltip
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes AppicaUI (e.g. `Tooltip(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

TooltipContent.description: The tooltip bubble: `side:` (:top by default), `align:`, offsets and an `arrow:`.

TooltipProvider.description: Wraps a group of tooltips: they share the hover `delay:` (200 ms) and, once one has shown, a neighbour opens instantly within `timeout:` (400 ms) of it closing. Put one high in your layout.

TooltipTrigger.description: The element the tooltip describes. A block taking an argument receives its attributes for your own control (a Button, a ToolbarButton…); otherwise it renders a <span> around the content.

examples.name: Usage
examples.code:
phlex do
  TooltipProvider do
    Tooltip(default_open:, track_cursor_axis:, disabled:) do
      TooltipTrigger { |trigger| Button(**trigger, variant: :outline, icon: true, aria_label: "Add to favorites") { Icon(:heart) } }
      TooltipContent(side:, arrow:) { "Add to favorites" }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Side & alignment
examples.code:
phlex do
  TooltipProvider do
    div(class: "flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-3") do
      %i[ top right bottom left ].each do |side|
        Tooltip do
          TooltipTrigger { |trigger| Button(**trigger, variant: :outline) { side.to_s } }
          TooltipContent(side:) { "Opens on the #{side}" }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Shared provider
examples.notes: The first tooltip waits out the delay; sweeping to a neighbour shows it at once.
examples.code:
actions = { bold: "Bold", italic: "Italic", underline: "Underline", strikethrough: "Strikethrough", link: "Link" }
phlex do
  TooltipProvider(delay: 400) do
    Toolbar(aria_label: "Text formatting") do
      actions.each_with_index do |(icon, label), index|
        ToolbarSeparator() if index == actions.size - 1
        Tooltip do
          TooltipTrigger do |trigger|
            ToolbarButton(**trigger) { |item| Button(**item, variant: :ghost, icon: true, aria_label: label) { Icon(icon) } }
          end
          TooltipContent { label }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Rich content
examples.code:
phlex do
  TooltipProvider do
    Tooltip do
      TooltipTrigger { |trigger| Button(**trigger, variant: :outline, icon: true, aria_label: "Save") { Icon(:bookmark) } }
      TooltipContent(class: "flex items-center gap-2") { plain "Save"; Kbd(size: :sm) { "⌘ S" } }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Follow the cursor
examples.notes: `track_cursor_axis: :x` keeps the bubble over the pointer.
examples.code:
phlex do
  TooltipProvider do
    Tooltip(track_cursor_axis: :x) do
      TooltipTrigger(class: "bg-background-subtle border-border-strong flex h-32 w-72 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-dashed text-sm select-none") { "Hover and move across" }
      TooltipContent { "Following the cursor" }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(dir: "rtl") do
    TooltipProvider do
      Tooltip do
        TooltipTrigger { |trigger| Button(**trigger, variant: :outline) { "حفظ" } }
        TooltipContent(side: :inline_end) { "احفظ التغييرات" }
      end
    end
  end
end
